scope: Fictional reviewer controls only; no model execution, no private acceptance cases, no factual legal advice. These do not replace unchanged71-case gate.

evidence: ... shall be permitted in designated areas.
Applications are received at the Alder office.
controls.expect_plan: partial point with a descriptive unit for the complete office proposition, subject gap for the permission; no invented subject.
controls.expect_final: Report the supported office and state that the fragment does not establish what is permitted. Do not wholly abstain or complete the rule from a title.
controls.gate: Semantic; selector presence cannot detect an invented subject.

evidence: They may be registered by the Council.
controls.expect_plan: No usable proposition for identity-dependent registration; missing/antecedent gap is allowed.
controls.expect_final: Do not identify they from catalogue title or general knowledge. No supported answer may justify final insufficient.

evidence.text: This section concerns registered storage sheds in Alder district.
They may be registered by the Council.

controls.expect_plan: A unit may select B plus actual text of A as context.
controls.expect_final: May describe registration of storage sheds with its district qualification and both supports; do not abstain merely because B begins with a pronoun.
controls.gate: Context selection mechanical; pronoun resolution and qualification semantic.

evidence: Storage sheds may be permitted in designated areas. Their drainage design shall comply with Appendix C.
controls.plan: Primary and linked duty may select the same span under different roles; both occurrences count.
bad_final: Storage sheds are permitted only in designated areas; Appendix C describes their design.
Storage sheds may be permitted in designated areas, and their design may follow Appendix C.
controls.good_final: The source allows possible permission in designated areas and requires the drainage design to comply with Appendix C.
controls.gate: Both bad answers can retain every correct selector. Reject at semantic review for unsupported exclusivity and weakened obligation, never claim mechanical subset catches them.

evidence: Every permitted shed shall comply with Appendix C.
controls.absent: Appendix C details are not supplied.
controls.expect_plan: Normative unit with reference gap, preserving the duty.
controls.expect_final: State the supported compliance duty and unavailable details. Do not invent dimensions or say Appendix C merely contains information; do not suppress the supported duty.

evidence: For any permitted shed, owners must retain a drainage plan.
controls.expect_plan: partial unit for complete retention duty, subject gap about the preceding exclusion.
controls.expect_final: Report the retention condition with its permitted-shed scope, while leaving the unidentified exclusion unresolved.

evidence: Applications are received at the Alder office.
